verdict.rationale: cubic lets users define rules that run automatically on pull-request events. Custom agents are review rules enforced across PRs, new PRs are reviewed automatically, and auto-approval, auto-fix and auto-resolve act on PRs without manual steps. This is limited to fixed PR-review events and a preset set of actions, not a general rule-to-action automation engine. Missing for 10: a general event/trigger model beyond PR reviews, user-defined custom actions or conditional rule→action chaining, documentation of the trigger semantics, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Custom agents are review rules that enforce your organization's specific best practices across pull requests.
Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
Enable [auto-approval](/ai-review/auto-approval) to let cubic approve PRs that meet your review policy.
turn on auto-fix to have cubic fix the issues from every review of a pull request.
Enable automatic thread resolution to close findings when the issue is fixed
